definitions.explanation: The seat or position of a king or queen. Used literally for a monarch's seat.
The position of champion or number one in a competition, sport, or field. Very common in sports and shogi/go contexts.

examples.english: The king sits on the throne.

examples.japanese: ⟦{革命|かくめい}→革命：05968_kakumei⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{王|おう}→王：19353_ou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{王座|おうざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追|お}われた→追う：02016_ou⟧。
examples.english: The king was driven from the throne by the revolution.
Throughout the long history, many kings ascended to this throne.

examples.japanese: {王座|おうざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
⟦{三年|さんねん}→三年：10984_sannen⟧⟦{連続|れんぞく}→連続：03783_renzoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{王座|おうざ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{輝|かがや}いた→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧。
examples.english: They won the championship for three years in a row.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若手|わかて}→若手：13989_wakate⟧⟦{棋士|きし}→棋士：27809_kishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{王座|おうざ}{戦|せん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{初|はつ}→初：10632_hatsu⟧⟦タイトル→タイトル：03855_taitoru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{獲得|かくとく}→獲得：05624_kakutoku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A young shogi player won their first title in the Oza tournament.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{王|おう}→王：19353_ou⟧ (king) + ⟦{座|ざ}→座：28170_za⟧ (seat). Used both literally for a royal throne and figuratively for the top position in competitive fields.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {王座|おうざ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就|つ}く→就く：10123_tsuku⟧: to ascend to the throne / to win the title
- {王座|おうざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to defend the title
- {王座|おうざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{奪|うば}う→奪う：01895_ubau⟧: to seize the title
- {王座|おうざ}{戦|せん}: Oza tournament (one of the eight major shogi titles)
- {王座|おうざ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{輝|かがや}く→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧: to shine as champion

CULTURAL NOTE:
{王座|おうざ}{戦|せん} is one of the eight major title matches in professional shogi (⟦{将棋|しょうぎ}→将棋：04172_shougi⟧). It is also used as a title in go (⟦{囲碁|いご}→囲碁：18035_igo⟧). In general sports reporting, {王座|おうざ} is commonly used to mean "the championship."

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {玉座|ぎょくざ}: throne (more literary; emphasizes the physical seat)
- ⟦チャンピオン→チャンピオン：19399_chanpion⟧: champion (loanword, more casual)
- ⟦{覇者|はしゃ}→覇者：24558_hasha⟧: champion, conqueror (literary, emphatic)
